research_question.description: Formal CGT research question for the human investigator. Follows the structure: 'What is the [pattern] of [population] and how do they continuously [processing_verb] it?' Singular, formal, process-oriented, references spatial and temporal frames.

operational_question.description: Operational question for LLM agents during DISCOVERY. Uses PLURAL pattern nouns because the specific pattern hasn't been identified yet. Format: 'How do [population] [processing_verb] their [pattern_plural]?' Process-oriented, concise, guides observation of patterns. Use conjugated verb form when instructions are in an inflected language.

rationale.description: Methodological explanation of how the object_of_study type, population, processing verb, spatial frame, and temporal frame shaped the question formulation.

key_dimensions.description: Key dimensions that agents should observe during the discovery phase, derived from the population assumption and object_of_study.

dimension.description: Name of the dimension to observe (e.g., 'Spatial mobility', 'Digital literacy', 'Social network').

rationale.description: Why this dimension is relevant given this population and object_of_study.
